vector_definition: V_basic=100*(F_FP32/27e12+F_BF16/54e12)/T_full. Only useful add/sub/mul/reductions counted, FMA=2. Mixed Vector precisions use summed ideal times as an accounting convention; not an occupancy measurement. Division, nonlinear functions, casts and comparisons are recorded separately without invented peak throughputs.
fusion_definition: C and V share full-kernel duration; never add percentages or call their sum fused MFU. No serial/full-overlap assumption is used. Full resource efficiency needs instruction-specific peaks and measured scheduling/overlap.
bound_caveat: Original bound labels preserved: activity-based heuristic, not a demonstrated causal bottleneck.

MBU_definition.peak_source: User explicitly supplied 850=1.4 TB/s,850E=4 TB/s in this chat. Decimal TB/s.
MBU_definition.scope: Cold-read logical useful bytes, once per invocation; NOT HBM counter measurements or measured occupancy. Fused on-chip intermediate tensors excluded.
MBU_definition.uncertainty: GMM uses user-requested ideal balanced routing,36 active experts/rank,48B useful rows/rank; sparse KV union still shown as range; pool position interval retained in CSV.
MBU_definition.aggregation: Sum bytes over all same-type invocations in main20 windows, divided by160; sum duration/160. Rank-average weights/traffic and rank-average duration; no extra factor8.
MBU_definition.cache_caveat: Cold balanced reference may exceed100%; this is not measured hardware occupancy. Do not infer caching alone: actual expert activation can also differ from the balanced reference.
MBU_definition.excluded: Padding, cache-line amplification, repeated reads, spills/workspace and synchronization are implementation traffic, absent from useful-byte model.
MBU_definition.prof_evidence: Existing kernel_details.csv examined for both B28 runs: only PipelineUtilization counters; no HBM byte or memory-bandwidth fields.
MBU_definition.GMM_balancing: All36 experts active. Mean4B/3 rows/expert; integer counts differ by at most1. This is a deterministic ideal-balanced reference, not random-uniform expected occupancy.
MBU_definition.display_filter: User requested removal of percentages above100. Hide entire MBU line when upper endpoint>100; retain original raw metric in this method/ledger, never clip to100. Curve/MFU/bound retained.
